title: Hooks in your own game
description:
Let mods run code before and after the game's own functions, through hook points you design.

```
before "damage": shield mod reduces 10 -> 6
game applies 6 damage
after "damage": stats mod counts the hit
a before-hook can cancel: invulnerable mod -> no damage
```
hints: Call every before-hook with the event, stop if it was cancelled, then do the work, then call the after-hooks (lesson 13.05).
Designing hook points yourself keeps mods working when the game's code changes inside.
requirements: Hook points are named; each has a list of before and after callbacks.
Before-callbacks can change the arguments or cancel; after-callbacks only see the result.
Callbacks run in the order mods were loaded.
stretch: Give each hook a priority so a mod can ask to run first.
